name: Phase 96 Nori Original Companion and Assistant Launcher Manual UI Evidence

testedInteractions: Floating launcher button renders in configured screen corner (bottom-right default) with safe insets offsetting bottom nav and banners
Displays original folded-paper origami character with 8 distinct expression states (idle, greeting, listening, thinking, success, error, offline, sleeping)
Hovering or keyboard focusing triggers gentle greeting fold without sound or recording activation
Left-clicking launcher triggers assistant dialog opening, switching character expression to greeting/listening
Right-clicking launcher triggers accessible context settings menu allowing instant corner relocation (bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right, top-left), reduced motion toggle, and hide companion option
Selecting 'Hide Nori' hides the floating widget immediately while keeping the labeled 'Ask Nori' header button accessible
Respects system prefers-reduced-motion media query and user in-app preference by eliminating floating and breathing animations (0ms durations)
Halts animation render loop when browser tab is hidden or minimized via document.visibilityState
Restores keyboard focus back to the companion launcher button when the assistant dialog is closed via Escape or Close button
Meets WCAG AA touch target minimum with 52px diameter button (> 48dp minimum)

accessibilityAttributes.ariaLabel: Derives truthful announcement per state (e.g., 'Nori: Assistant is listening')
accessibilityAttributes.keyboardNavigation: Fully focusable via Tab, activatable via Enter and Space, dismissible context menu via Escape

testedInteractions: Header displays labeled 'Ask Nori' button with inline folded-paper nori icon
Clicking button opens the same unified assistant session controller as the floating companion
Allows users who choose to hide the floating companion to retain uninterrupted access to assistant capabilities
Floating companion button renders in safe corner above bottom navigation bar (64dp height + 16dp margin = 80dp bottom offset)
Enforces 52x52dp touch target satisfying Android minimum 48dp accessibility guideline
Truthfully adapts border and background colors according to connection state (e.g. muted slate when offline, amber when listening, danger when error)
Tapping launcher opens AssistantSheet modal smoothly
Hides automatically when user preferences specify noriCompanion.enabled: false
Adapts positioning safely to avoid obscuring bottom tabs across portrait and landscape orientations

accessibilityAttributes.accessibilityLabel: TalkBack announcement dynamically generated based on current Nori state
